{{Quote|The drum corps has begun, I believe it's a percussion arrangement of 'Tialga Hath Fallen,' a traditional Aldeeraanian air about a warrior-queen who makes a stand against impossible odds so her children can reach safe haven. Yes, that's it indeed, and you can hear the polyphonic tones of the sequential bells substituting for the Alderaanian flutes in this arrangement.|Javis Tyrr|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
'''Alderaanian flutes''' were traditional [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] instruments. They were used to play the Alderaanian air, "[[Tialga Hath Fallen]]." The air was played by the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy]] [[Galactic Alliance Navy Drum Corps|Drum Corps]] during [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]]'s [[Funeral of Cha Niathal|funeral]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], although the Alderaanian flutes were replaced by [[sequential bell]]s. [[Journalist/Legends|Journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]], reporting on the funeral for the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], recognized and made note of the substitution of bells for the Alderaanian flutes.
